claims.statement: Joe Goss put up a $500 forfeit in Cincinnati and Tom Allen covered the same amount.
claims.excerpt: Goss put up $500 in Cincinnati, and Allen has covered the amount.

claims.statement: Goss's and Allen's representatives were to meet at Cincinnati on May 12 to agree the purse, which was open from $1,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: are to meet at Cin-cinnati on the 12th inst., to agree upon the purse to be fought for

claims.statement: Tom Allen was prepared to fight Joe Goss for any amount Allen named, within twelve weeks of May 2, 1876.
claims.excerpt: he is prepared with the money to fight Goss for any amount he may name, within twelve weeks from this date

claims.statement: Tom Allen expected to make a satisfactory match with Goss, to be fought in the Southwest.
claims.excerpt: a satisfactory match with Goss to be fought in the Southwest.

claims.statement: Tom Allen weighed 195 pounds and could reduce to about 178 pounds, his fighting weight, within twelve weeks.
claims.excerpt: Allen weighs now one hundred and ninety-five pounds, and can easily reduce himself to

claims.statement: Tom Allen expressed contempt for a man printed as 'burn' and for his gang, who had made bold threats.
claims.excerpt: his contempt for burn and “his gang,” who made bold threats

notes: Paper paraphrases Allen throughout; no direct speech. The name printed as 'burn' is unreadable.
